scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and separately checked finite-state exact arithmetic. Finite state tests are not an infinite proof. Homogeneous complete-graph flooding and general transmitter-heterogeneity literature are acknowledged; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite complete graphs, irreversible exponential-contact SI transmission, one initially susceptible slow vertex and one ordinary initial seed. Limiting time law requires rho_N in (0,1], the critical positive finite limit requires rho_N log N -> c>0, and only the leading log N scale is established. Historical originality evidence is not exhaustive.
title: A logarithmic slow-vertex crossover in complete-graph SI flooding
